brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases in a line: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full, piece:3,0,0;full. Each fitted with hex-bin-third-drain (third-depth drained bin suitable for planting) – bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain etc. check_build meshClash=clear.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 created with addRun level 0 start 0,0,0 entryEdge 3 through [1,0,0],[2,0,0],[3,0,0] – pipe passes sideways through all four cells. Third-depth bins used as required to clear the pipe; check_build confirms no mesh clash.

finish.summary: Four-cell linear planter (0,0,0–3,0,0) each with a drained third-depth bin, fed by a single horizontal run (run-1) that traverses all four bases. Bins are third-depth to clear the pipe and build verifies mesh-clear.

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
